# Vendored Moss core provenance

This directory is copied from `packages/core` in `nishuzumi/moss` at upstream commit `97df9c1a43f2c592fbdebee267a250e6a21f341e` (repository `main` as inspected on 2026-08-03).

It is temporarily vendored because npm package `@themoss/core@0.1.0` exposes an older Plan API, while the current Moss repository uses Capability trees and verified Receipt parsers. AdMon targets the current repository API. The upstream MIT license is retained in this directory.
